query:
UPDATE brackets b
SET maxPossiblePoints = (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN p.isCorrect = 1 THEN p.pointsEarned
      WHEN p.isCorrect IS NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE 'FirstFour%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 8, 5)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%round64%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 15, 10)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%round32%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 30, 20)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%sweet16%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 60, 40)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%elite8%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 120, 80)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%finalfour%' OR p.matchupId LIKE '%FinalFour%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 240, 160)
          WHEN p.matchupId LIKE '%championship%' OR p.matchupId LIKE '%Championship%' THEN IF(p.isUpset, 480, 320)
          ELSE 10
        END
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0)
  FROM picks p WHERE p.bracketId = b.id
);
